# Decorom — Handcrafted Luxury Designer Nameplates

> Decorom is an established designer entrance decor brand and manufacturing studio based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. With a 4.9-star rating across 41+ verified Google reviews, Decorom crafts premium personalized nameplates in 3D Acrylic, Hand-Carved Teak Wood, Weatherproof ACP, Architectural Mild Steel, SS 304 Stainless Steel, and Hand-Poured Resin Art.

## Product Collections & Studio Tools
- [Complete Product Catalog](https://www.decorom.in/products): Explore 60+ handcrafted customizable nameplate models for flats, villas, bungalows, and offices.
- [Our Best Sellers Rail](https://www.decorom.in/best-sellers): The most favored and top-rated entrance door nameplate designs in India.
- [Interactive 2D/3D Customizer](https://www.decorom.in/custom-design): Real-time online nameplate design studio allowing visitors to type their family names in English, Hindi, or Gujarati, pick dimensions, and preview warm LED backlighting.

## Material Category Directory
- [Acrylic Nameplates](https://www.decorom.in/category/acrylic): Ultra-glossy, 100% waterproof 3D embossed and warm white LED backlit acrylic door plates starting at ₹799.
- [Wooden Nameplates](https://www.decorom.in/category/wooden): Natural Teak wood, steam beech, and rustic live-edge wood slices coated with marine PU polish and termite sealant starting at ₹999.
- [ACP (Aluminium Composite Panel) Nameplates](https://www.decorom.in/category/acp): Weatherproof and fire-retardant aluminium composite panels in rich wood textures and metallic finishes for exterior gates and exposed walls starting at ₹1,299.
- [Mild Steel (MS) Laser-Cut Nameplates](https://www.decorom.in/category/mild-steel): Heavy-gauge architectural steel precision laser-cut with family names and motifs, finished with 7-tank anti-rust powder coating starting at ₹1,440.
- [Stainless Steel (SS 304) Nameplates](https://www.decorom.in/category/stainless-steel): Permanent rustproof SS 304 plates in Electroplated Titanium Gold PVD, Rose Gold, and acid-etched advocate/doctor chamber plates starting at ₹2,999.
- [Resin Art Nameplates](https://www.decorom.in/category/resin): Bespoke hand-poured epoxy resin door plates infused with natural pressed flowers, metallic gold leafing, and ocean wave textures starting at ₹2,999.
